findings.problem: Production unsafe block using std::mem::transmute to reinterpret [u8;4] as u32. Holzman Rust forbids all production unsafe.
findings.failure_mode: transmute ignores endianness — on big-endian targets the returned u32 is byte-swapped relative to little-endian callers, producing silently corrupted length values; undefined behavior if the compiler assumes the source and destination have different provenance or if alignment assumptions are violated.
findings.fix: Replace with u32::from_le_bytes([input[0], input[1], input[2], input[3]]) or use bytemuck::cast::<_, u32> behind a checked, bounded constructor that returns a Result/Option. Add a bounds check or return Result<u32, LengthError> to handle inputs shorter than 4 bytes.

findings.problem: Direct array indexing input[0]..input[3] without bounds validation. Panics on inputs shorter than 4 bytes.
findings.failure_mode: Out-of-bounds access on inputs < 4 bytes causes a synchronous panic, aborting the thread instead of returning a typed error.
findings.fix: Return Result<u32, ReadLenError> and use input.get(0..4).and_then(|s| s.try_into().ok()).map(u32::from_le_bytes), or use checked indexing via .get() with early return.

findings.problem: Function reads 4 bytes but has no documented endianness contract. Implicit little-endian assumption encoded in transmute, not in the API.
findings.failure_mode: Callers on big-endian or mixed-endian systems get silently wrong values. The API is non-portable without explicit documentation.
findings.fix: Use u32::from_le_bytes, u32::from_be_bytes, or u32::from_ne_bytes explicitly to make endianness a visible part of the type contract.

findings.failure_mode: Cannot verify whether transmute provides a real performance benefit over from_le_bytes, or whether the function is even hot-path worthy.
findings.fix: Add a criterion or tinybench benchmark comparing transmute vs from_le_bytes under the expected workload, with profiler call graphs and allocation profiles.

findings.failure_mode: Regressions in byte-order behavior, bounds handling, or API contract changes go undetected.
findings.fix: Add behavior tests covering: exactly 4 bytes (multiple values), inputs of length 0-3 (should return error or Option::None), and verify expected u32 output for known byte arrays.
